observations: Order of work: I read the request first. Then I opened main-cast.png, nurse.png, checkin-patients.png and pharmacy-lab.png, then assets/panels/04-1.png and workflow/review/page-04.png, and looked at each image myself.

04-1 is a wide eye-level shot of the waiting area. Ravi stands and smiles up at the wall TV in the upper right. He matches the main-cast sheet: side-parted short black hair, thick straight brows, smile creases, trimmed beard, square jaw, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers.

Hands match the production notes. His left hand grips the dark-brown bag strap on his left shoulder, with the wristwatch visible on that wrist. His right hand is pushed into his trouser pocket. The phone itself is not visible, so the 'tucking away' reads as a hand in the pocket, which is consistent with the phone ending up there.

The TV has a light-teal screen with one empty white strip and no text or numbers. The QR stand at the left shows only an abstract block pattern. The vitals cart monitor shows abstract shapes. The reception monitor faces Meera. I found no readable text anywhere.

The two foreground chairs to screen-left of Ravi are empty, consistent with Mr. Raman and Priya having been called. Two background figures are seen from behind, one in grey and one in brown. Meera types at the desk at the right in a blue kurta, braid over her left shoulder, with a round face and round eyes as on her sheet.

On page-04.png the caption sits on the plain upper-left wall. The NOW · A-12 label covers only the TV's empty strip. Neither covers a face, hand or the bag. The new page 8 and the pharmacy-lab sheet do not affect this panel.
